title: WARHORN
description: A one-against-one mobile war game. Grow a glowing town from your corner, choose farms or barracks, and march core to core. Four and a half minutes, fully public information, no micro.
longDescription:
WARHORN is a one-against-one town-building war game for the phone.

Grow a town from your corner. Every tile is a choice: a farm pays gold each turn, a barracks sends soldiers with every horn. Soldiers march core to core along the lanes, meet in the middle and annihilate one for one. Raid their income, break their gates, siege the core. Four and a half minutes, then the horn ends it.

**What you get:**

- **Real opponents:** play a friend by code, or queue and be matched.
- **Fully public information:** you see their town, they see yours. No fog, no hidden hands.
- **No micro:** you place buildings and pick lanes; the armies march themselves.
- **Characters:** choose who stands on your castle.
- **Free to play:** earn silver by playing, or buy a pack; silver unlocks characters and nothing you buy changes a match.
- **Sign in with Apple or Google:** your name, friends and rating follow you to a new phone.

legal.privacyPolicy:
WARHORN is a one-against-one town-building war game. You sign in with Apple on iPhone or with Google on Android, build a town, and march on a friend's or a stranger's. This page says what we keep, why, and what you can do about it.

Who is responsible

Junghard Software AB (org.nr 559217-6753), Jans väg 5, Göteborg, Sweden. Questions: support@junghard.com.

What we keep

  • Your sign-in. An id from Apple or from Google. On iPhone we ask Apple for nothing else: no name, no email. On Android, Google also shares the email address of the Google account you chose; we store it and do not use it.
  • Your name and your character. The name you type when you first play is shown to opponents and friends. The character you choose to show stays on your phone.
  • Your silver and your characters. Your silver balance, the characters you have unlocked, and a history of the silver you earn and spend.
  • Your purchases. For each silver pack you buy: which pack, when, the store's transaction id, and the store's own confirmation that the payment went through. We use it to credit the silver and to make sure a purchase is only ever credited once.
  • Your friends. Your friend code, the friends you add, and the players you block or remove.
  • Your play. The result of each online match, your progress on the season track and the daily quest, and when ranked play opens, your rating and win/loss record for the season. While the game is open, friends can see whether you are on the home screen or in a match.
  • Technical. A session key on your phone so you stay signed in; on installs from before sign-in existed, the device key that account started with; and ordinary server logs (connection times and IP addresses) kept for a short time to keep the service running.

We never ask for your date of birth, your address or your phone number. Silver packs are paid for through Apple or Google; they handle the payment and we never see your card or your payment details.

Where it is

On our own server in the EU (the Netherlands). Everything between the game and the server is encrypted.

Who sees it

Your friends see your name, your status and the matches you play against them. An opponent sees your name and your character during a match. Leaderboards, when ranked play opens, show names and ratings. Nobody else. We do not sell or share your data, show no ads, and do not track you across other apps or sites.

How long

Until you delete it. DELETE ACCOUNT on the account sheet removes your account and everything tied to it at once. The one exception is the purchase record: which pack was bought, when, the store's transaction id and its confirmation stay on the server for our accounts, with nothing left that links them to you. Server backups are overwritten within 30 days.

Your rights

  • See and change: your name is in the game and can be changed there; your friends list too.
  • Delete: DELETE ACCOUNT on the account sheet, or see the deletion page.
  • Get a copy: email support@junghard.com.
  • Complain: the Swedish Authority for Privacy Protection, imy.se.

Children

WARHORN is not directed at children under 13, and we do not knowingly keep anything about them. If you believe a child has an account, email us and we delete it.

Changes

If this text changes we update the date at the top. Bigger changes are announced in the game.

For the App Store and Google Play

Data linked to you: identifiers (a user id, your sign-in id), contact info (an email address on Android only), user content (your name), gameplay content (match results, season progress, rating), and purchases (the silver packs you buy). Nothing is used for tracking or advertising.
legal.termsOfService:
WARHORN is free to play. By playing you accept these terms.

Your account

You sign in with Apple or Google. One account per player. You can delete your account at any time from the account sheet in the game; deletion is immediate and cannot be undone.

Fair play

Play the game as it is meant to be played. We may rename, suspend or remove accounts that cheat, exploit bugs, use a name that is offensive or impersonates someone, or harass other players. The rules of the game, including balance and ranked seasons, can change between updates.

Your name

The name you choose is shown to other players. Choose one you are happy to show, and do not use another person's name or brand.

Availability

We do our best to keep the game and its servers running, but cannot promise it is always available or free of bugs. Online play needs a working connection; a match that is lost to a dropped connection counts by the game's own rules.

Purchases

Silver is the game's currency. You earn it by playing and on the season track, and you can buy it in packs. Silver unlocks characters, which change who stands on your castle, not how a match plays. Payments are handled by Apple or Google under their terms, and refunds go through them. Silver and characters are a licence to use them in the game: they have no cash value, cannot be traded, transferred or exchanged for money, and are lost when you delete your account. Season rewards are claimed by pressing CLAIM; a reward not claimed by the end of its season is gone. We may change prices and what the shop offers between updates.

Liability

The game is provided as is. Junghard Software AB is not liable for indirect damages. Swedish law applies.

Changes

We may change these terms. If you keep playing after a change, you accept it.

Contact

support@junghard.com
legal.deleteAccount:
How to delete your WARHORN account and everything tied to it. It takes a minute and needs no contact with us.

In the game

  1. Open WARHORN and sign in.
  2. On the home screen, tap the account button in the bottom-right corner (the person glyph).
  3. Tap DELETE ACCOUNT.
  4. Confirm with DELETE.

Your account is gone at once and the game returns to the sign-in screen. You can sign in again later to start over with a fresh account.

What is deleted

Your account (your Apple or Google sign-in and, on Android, the email address Google shared), your name, your friend code and your friends list both ways, your match results, your rating and win/loss record, your season progress, your silver, and the characters you unlocked. Silver and characters cannot be moved to another account or refunded by us. Every session is signed out.

What is kept

Nothing linked to you. For each silver pack bought, the record of which pack, when, the store's transaction id and its confirmation stays for our accounts, with nothing that links it to you. There is no waiting period: deletion is immediate and cannot be undone. Server backups are overwritten within 30 days.

Cannot open the game?

Email support@junghard.com from the address you signed in with, or tell us your friend code, and we delete the account for you within seven days.
